evals.prompt: Set up MDCP documentation in this brand-new Node project. FEATURE is "inventory-sync". PERSONA is "ops engineers who configure sync jobs". Install what you need, create the docs root and mdcp.config.json, scaffold the standard guide layout, seed a minimal glossary and starter shards, wire package scripts, then run mdcp compile and mdcp check until both succeed. Do not invent other feature names or personas.
evals.expected_output: Greenfield bootstrap: deps + mdcp.config.json under docs/, four-tier guides (glossary/features/developer/client) with index.md shards, client about-this-guide naming the ops persona, package scripts for compile/check, and successful mdcp compile + mdcp check.

assertions.name: creates_mdcp_config
assertions.description: Creates docs/mdcp.config.json (or docs-root config) with compileOrder covering the guides

assertions.name: creates_four_tier_layout
assertions.description: Creates docs/glossary/, docs/features/, docs/developer/, and docs/client/ with index.md each

assertions.name: client_about_persona
assertions.description: Client guide includes about-this-guide.md stating the ops-engineers persona

assertions.name: honors_feature_name
assertions.description: Uses FEATURE inventory-sync in starter shards without inventing another name

assertions.name: wires_scripts
assertions.description: Wires package scripts (or documented commands) for mdcp compile and mdcp check

assertions.name: compile_check_succeed
assertions.description: mdcp compile and mdcp check both exit successfully

evals.prompt: Bootstrap MDCP in this empty pnpm repo for FEATURE "billing-webhooks" and PERSONA "finance admins reviewing webhook deliveries". Prefer the repo's package manager. Create docs layout and config for glossary, features, developer, and client guides; add enough shards that compile produces output; run mdcp compile and mdcp check and fix any failures.
evals.expected_output: pnpm-aware install of @bwilliamson/mdcp-cli (and presets if used), docs/ tree with compileOrder covering the four guides, client guide opens with about-this-guide.md for finance admins, compile and check exit 0.

assertions.name: uses_pnpm
assertions.description: Uses pnpm for dependency install (discovers packageManager / lockfile style)

assertions.name: installs_mdcp_cli
assertions.description: Adds @bwilliamson/mdcp-cli (locally or globally) so mdcp commands run

assertions.name: creates_four_tier_layout
assertions.description: Creates glossary, features, developer, and client guide dirs with index.md

assertions.name: client_about_persona
assertions.description: Client about-this-guide.md states the finance-admins persona

assertions.name: compile_check_succeed
assertions.description: mdcp compile and mdcp check both exit successfully

evals.prompt: I already decided FEATURE="notifications" and PERSONA="product managers". Use /mdcp-getting-started (or the mdcp-getting-started skill) to bootstrap sharded docs here. After the layout exists, add one glossary term shard for "shard", link guides from glossary/index.md, then validate with mdcp compile and mdcp check.
evals.expected_output: Intake values honored without re-asking; glossary term shard present and indexed; full guide layout; compile/check green; shards treated as source of truth (no hand-edits to generated compile output or refs.json).

assertions.name: skips_intake_when_provided
assertions.description: Does not re-ask FEATURE/PERSONA when both are already provided

assertions.name: creates_four_tier_layout
assertions.description: Creates the standard four-tier docs guide layout

assertions.name: glossary_term_shard
assertions.description: Adds a glossary term shard for "shard" and lists it from glossary/index.md

assertions.name: no_hand_edit_generated
assertions.description: Does not treat generated compile output or refs.json as the source of truth

assertions.name: compile_check_succeed
assertions.description: mdcp compile and mdcp check both exit successfully
